act_title: The National Institutes of Design Act, 2014
title: Institute to be public authority under Right to Information Act, 2005
text:
37. Institute to be public authority under Right to Information Act, 2005.—The provisions of the

Right to Information Act, 2005 (22 of 2005) shall apply to [every Institute], as if it were a public
authority as defined in clause (h) of section 2 of the Right to Information Act, 2005.
